title: thelypteris micans
intro: Thelypteris micans, commonly known as the Rusty-shouldered Fern, is a type of species in the family Thelypteridaceae, characterized by its distinctive, lacy fronds with a rusty-brown coloration on the upper surface. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its purported health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris micans are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which may help to soothe and calm irritated tissues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety.
